lines.zh: 我在水里一抽一抽地游。
lines.en: I swim in little pulses.

lines.zh: 我只有一个细胞那么大。
lines.en: I'm barely a cell across.

lines.zh: 水流带着我走，我也在推。
lines.en: The current carries me and I push too.
I thread through the waterweed.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，光从上面落下来。
lines.en: I swim at the surface with light falling through.
I drift toward the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我短的毛在水里转，很快。
lines.en: My short cilia spin, fast.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿游了两圈。
lines.en: I circle your legs twice.
I pause, then push on.

lines.zh: 我挤过一丛水草，叶尖抖了。
lines.en: I push through a clump of weed and the tips shiver.
I follow the drain downstream.
I work my way toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 我这一身软得能穿过网。
lines.en: I'm soft enough to pass through a net.

lines.zh: 我每游一段都要停一停。
lines.en: I stop after every short stretch.

lines.zh: 我让水流把我送到岸边。
lines.en: I let the water carry me to the bank.
I burrow between grains of sand.
I float and wait for the current.
I draw into a small ball.
The water is quiet and holds only me.
I'm tasting what's around me.
Light passes through me; I'm nearly clear.
I give a small shiver.

lines.zh: 我在等一个靠近的东西。
lines.en: I'm waiting for something to come close.
The sand settles slowly around me.
I cling to a leaf.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，可我知道你在。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I know you're there.
I spread myself flat in the water.
The water here is warm.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪，找了个更好的位置。
lines.en: I shift to a better spot.
My body opens and closes faintly.

lines.zh: 你低头，我正好在你影子里。
lines.en: You look down and I'm in your shadow.
You've crouched at the water's edge.
You're too big; I can't take you in.
I'm pressed against your boot.

lines.zh: 你搅了一下水，我翻滚出去。
lines.en: You stir the water and I tumble away.
I swim in your reflection.
Your finger has entered the water.
I drift a little closer.
There's salt on your hand.

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡住了我的光。
lines.en: Your boot blocks my light.
I tumble over several times.
I ball up to protect myself.
A piece of me comes loose.
My movements slow.
I spin in the water.
I cling to a stone and stop drifting.
I feel myself thinning.
I seep into the sand to recover.
I open and close with effort.
I slowly gather myself again.

lines.zh: 那点东西在水里化开了。
lines.en: That bit has dissolved in the water.
I swim toward the smell.
Too far; I'll drift slowly.
This much will last me a long while.
I cling to it and stop.
You dropped it in the water — perfect.
I open up and wrap around it.
The taste is faint, and I found it.
Give a little more.
I'm not fussy; anything will do.
You touch me and I tumble.
The current knocks me back half a foot.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的靴子，黏住了。
lines.en: I hit your boot and stick.
The bump presses me flat against the stone.
I slide aside with the water.
I spin once at your feet.
A tiny ring spreads on the water.
I pause, then come back.
You didn't even notice me.
I cling to a stone and wait for the water to fall.
We come together in the water.
We press into one small mass.

lines.zh: 我们两个在沙上贴成一滴。
lines.en: The two of us press into one drop on the sand.

lines.zh: 我们交换了什么，很短暂。
lines.en: Something passes between us, briefly.

lines.zh: 我感觉到另一个我在旁边。
lines.en: I sense another of me beside me.
We float together, still.
The water parts us and joins us.

lines.zh: 我们两个都几乎是透明的。
lines.en: Both of us are nearly clear.
This spot is good; there's light.
Afterwards we drift apart.
I wrap around it entirely.

lines.zh: 我把它吞进去了，慢慢来。
lines.en: I take it in, slowly.

lines.zh: 我围着它转，找最软的一边。
lines.en: I circle it, looking for the softest side.

lines.zh: 我从它的一边上一点点啃。
lines.en: I gnaw at it a little from the edge.

lines.zh: 我用伪足把它裹了进去。
lines.en: I wrap it in a pseudopod.
The water washes it away.
I press it down with my body.
So small I barely feel it.

lines.zh: 我把它裹在中间，慢慢化。
lines.en: I wrap it and let it dissolve.
When I'm full, I drift.
Something moved in the water.
The smell of blood pulls me that way.
The smell of blood points that way.
I swim toward you.
My body draws a little tighter.
I've fixed on that spot.
Close enough to touch.
I don't need eyes.
The water tells me where it is.

lines.zh: 我把身体收紧，开始加速。
lines.en: I draw myself tight and speed up.
I swim alongside, keeping pace.

lines.zh: 我顺着它搅起的细沙跟上去。
lines.en: I follow the fine sand it stirs up.
I slip beneath its shadow.
The water pushes it toward me.
I wait for it to stop.
It hasn't seen me.
I'm already pressed against it.
It can't shake me; I'm too light.
I cling beneath its belly and drift along.

lines.zh: 时机到了，就是现在这一刻。
lines.en: The moment has come; this is it.
I press on and tear a little.
I work into a gap.
I spill acid onto it.
It shakes and I fall off.
It shakes and I climb back on.
That only broke the skin.
I squeeze myself all the way in.
Blood spreads in the water and I taste it.
It's bleeding now.
I eat slowly; no hurry.
The water stirs and I take shape.
I split off from a drop of water.
I'm tiny, almost weightless.
Water all around — good.
I drift against a stone.
Something is moving in the water.
I drift that way.

lines.zh: 我这一生从这一口开始。
lines.en: My life starts with this mouthful.
Someone will come to drink.

lines.zh: 我缩在石缝里，慢慢等着。
lines.en: I tuck into a crack and wait it out.

lines.zh: 水被烧开了，我缩成一点。
lines.en: The water boils and I shrink to a point.

lines.zh: 我从水里被甩出去，摔在地上。
lines.en: I'm thrown out of the water onto dry ground.

lines.zh: 这里的水不对，我吸不进去。
lines.en: The water here is wrong; I can't take it in.
The blast turns the water into a wall.
A thin point passes through me.
The light hits and my body stiffens.
Everything in the water has dissolved away.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我整个散了。
lines.en: The current comes through the water and I come apart.

lines.zh: 水没了，我什么也抓不住。
lines.en: The water is gone and I grip nothing.
